releaseNotes: Public preview SDK for NexatomTT on Linux x64, built and tested on Ubuntu 24.04 under WSL2.
Includes standalone C/C++ projects and Python examples for channel setup, processed acquisition, raw time tags, saving and offline analysis.

Native API owns model discovery and automatic runtime entry. ZYNQ_004 internal-pulse checks passed for service return, all six C/C++/Python processed/raw workflows, saved-file decoding, digital delay through 256 ns and close/reopen.

Follow the included FTDI USB access instructions. Single active instrument; Kintex and legacy Zynq qualification for this preview and external analog validation remain pending. Firmware is supplied separately.
